steps.title: Sketch the vee profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Line: draw the outline with the vee in the top, starting at the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 80 wide, 50 high, the vee 40 across the top and 20 deep, centred. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the block
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 50 mm, into the screen. Click OK.

steps.title: Cut the relief slot
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Rectangle 8 wide, centred on the vee, from 8 below the bottom of the vee to above it.
Finish Sketch. Extrude, Boolean: Cut, Extents: Through All. Click OK.
steps.note: The relief slot gives clearance so a round bar sits on the two faces of the vee.

steps.title: Cut the base slot
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Rectangle 30 wide and 6 high, centred on the bottom edge.
Finish Sketch. Extrude, Boolean: Cut, Through All. Click OK.
